name: Electron Cash
description: Electron Cash's Qt updater retrieves a JSON version announcement, accepts newer matching variants only when the message verifies under one of three hard-coded Bitcoin Cash addresses, and presents the project download page. The checked-in flow performs notification and manual download rather than automatic installation.
limitations: This is a newly retrieved default-branch snapshot rather than the original study release; the claim is limited to the inspected Qt checker and does not generalize to other platform front ends.
